tools.name: verify_audit_receipt
tools.description: Verify an EdgeScreen Ed25519 signed audit receipt or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT for $0.00, without a wallet. Returns valid, receiptType, signerPublicKey, payloadSummary and verifiedAt using trusted server public keys. Unknown keys or tampering return valid=false; no payment or payout confirmation.

signedReceipt.description: Base64url signedReceipt from an audit or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT header.

tools.name: preview_x402_challenge
tools.description: Free zero-wallet x402 challenge quickcheck: verdict, top_finding and upgrade_hint. Inspects supplied JSON or headers only; no DNS, chain lookups or payload logging.

micro_call.description: Assert a micro-call ceiling of $1.00 USD.

openapi.description: Optional JSON OpenAPI operation or document; never fetched.

tools.name: screen_x402_challenge
tools.description: Inspect x402 v1/v2 challenges for spoofed stablecoins, decimal inflation, price mismatch, unsafe recipients and SSRF URLs. Pinned mainnet tokens on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. Returns all findings, nominal USD estimate and Ed25519 receipt. $0.002 (2000 atomic) Base USDC.

inputSchema.description: A raw x402 challenge or {challenge, advertised_price_usd?, micro_call?, openapi?}. Also accepts {headers, body?}, payment_required or www_authenticate. Supplied content only; URLs are never fetched.

tools.name: preview_mcp_manifest
tools.description: Free, zero-wallet deterministic MCP manifest or SKILL.md quickcheck: risk, severity, findingCount and manifestPinSha256. No external lookups or payload storage. Full findings, remediation and signed receipt: screen_mcp_manifest ($0.003 Base USDC).
